# Sample Synthetic Report

## Overview

This is a small, entirely synthetic Markdown fixture used directly by
`tests/test_parsers.py` to exercise the Markdown parser against a real file on
disk (as opposed to the inline fixtures most other tests build in a temp
directory). It contains no real-world content and is safe to redistribute.

## Findings

The synthetic storage capacity figure grew across the two synthetic planning
cycles described in this fixture.

The synthetic retirement schedule for synthetic coal assets moved later in
the second synthetic planning cycle described in this fixture.

## Conclusion

This concluding section exists only to give the parser a third heading level
to walk through during tests.
